project.name: jogo-acoes-parent
project.description: Reactor aggregator only -- not a shared Maven parent. `app` (Spring Boot), `email-lambda` (Quarkus) and `blackbox-proxy` (Spring Boot, spec 05-020) each need their own framework's parent/BOM for plugin/dependency management, and Maven doesn't support inheriting from two parents at once. This POM just lets `mvn` build all three from the repository root; each module's own pom.xml is otherwise independent.
